_comment: EWL-FOLD BENEFIT arm — the measurement nobody ever made.
Baseline is _golden0729_net50_30ep_wl1off.json (WL-1 float layer OFF, since that is
measured net-harmful this session), so the ONLY functional delta is:
network.mw_wl.ewl_fold_rows : false -> true
That isolates 'what does injecting the near-perfect EWL/UWL integers BUY?' with no
WL-1 confound.
WHY: the EWL/UWL decision tiers fix ~8792 integers per 31 epochs at mean R = 0.0001
cyc^2 (100% FFR-fixed) on bands 5/6/7/8 — and network_estimability.csv shows that the
two SOFTEST ESTIMABLE directions of the reduced shared normal matrix, every single
epoch, are third-band Galileo phase/code biases on exactly those bands:
ep1  ev 1.29e-2  PB|E08|L5X, PB|E08|L8X, PB|E14|L5X, PB|E13|L5X
ep1  ev 1.24e-2  PB|E09|L5X, CB|E09|C5X, PB|E09|L8X, PB|E09|L7X
ep3  ev 1.62e-2  PB|E18|L5X, PB|E18|L8X, PB|E18|L7X, PB|E18|L6X
against ev_max ~4.8e5.  The stranded integer information sits precisely on the states
the network is worst at determining.
PRIOR ART + THE GAP: ewl_fold_rows was previously rejected on CHURN COST (D5 679 vs
348 on a healthy network).  No one measured the BENEFIT.  The loader warns this is an
'F-A STUDY SHAPE'; that is exactly what this is — a diagnostic study arm, default-OFF.
PRIMARY METRIC (network_sh_spectrum.csv, per epoch, 31 rows): ev1..ev5 (the five
smallest eigenvalues) and mass_pb / span_pb (eigenvector mass partitioned by family).
If folding the EWL integers lifts the soft end of the spectrum materially, the prize is
real and fixing the foldReducedDdPriors composition is justified.  If ev1..ev5 barely
move, the integer information is not where we think it is and the whole MW/WL cascade
can be closed with confidence.  Either result is decisive.
SECONDARY (the known cost, for the trade): n_d5_flags / n_slip_refloats /
sigma0_pf_code / clock_std_m / worst_dev_m from network_epoch_status.csv.
CAVEAT: these rows fold through the SAME foldReducedDdPriors call as the Card-4 carry
blocks and share ambiguity columns, so they inherit the documented non-composition
(NetworkNormalEquations.hpp:395; dropped cross term).  A measured benefit here is
therefore a LOWER BOUND on what an exactly-composed injection would give.
